In emerging markets and developing economies, the growth is expected to slow down to 3.7% in 2025 and 3.9% in 2026. Heightened downside risks significantly influence the economic outlook. Company. The allegations in the complaint relate to a security incident experienced by the Client. The Company provided the Client with outsourced staffing for an employee help desk (“Service Desk”).
